title: JavaDsaUtils.java
subtitle: Java warm-up and handy helpers for DSA — the whole toolkit on one page.
meta: Run it: java JavaDsaUtils.java · or javac JavaDsaUtils.java && java JavaDsaUtils · Python twin: Python helpers · source: JavaDsaUtils.java

sections.title: 📇 0. Syntax Cheat Sheet
sections.lede: Read-only reference — the Java you actually type under time pressure.

sheet.label: Swap
sheet.code: int t = a; a = b; b = t;

sheet.label: List
sheet.code:
List<Integer> l = new ArrayList<>(); l.add(x); l.get(i);
l.remove(l.size()-1);  l.set(i, v);  l.contains(x) (O(n)!)

sheet.label: HashMap
Set
sheet.code: Set<Integer> seen = new HashSet<>(); seen.add(x); seen.contains(x)

sheet.label: Heap
sheet.code:
PriorityQueue<Integer> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();       // min
new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.reverseOrder());          // max
new PriorityQueue<>((a,b) -> a[1] - b[1]);               // by field

sheet.label: StringBuilder
sheet.code:
StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(); sb.append(c);
sb.reverse(); sb.toString();   // NEVER s += c in a loop

sheet.label: Boxing gotcha
sheet.code: Integer a = 128, b = 128; a == b is FALSE. Use .equals()

sections.title: 📦 Imports You Actually Use
sections.lede: Paste this header and stop thinking about imports.

helpers.name: isPalindrome
helpers.doc: Two-pointer palindrome check, ignoring non-alphanumerics and case.

helpers.name: charIndex
helpers.doc: 'a' -> 0 ... 'z' -> 25. Use for int[26] buckets.

helpers.name: alphaCounts
helpers.doc: Fixed 26-slot count — faster than a HashMap for letters-only input.

helpers.name: isAnagram
groupAnagrams
helpers.doc: Sorted-chars signature as the map key. LinkedHashMap keeps input order.

helpers.name: reverse
twoSumSorted
helpers.doc: Converging two pointers on a SORTED array. Returns indices or {-1,-1}.

helpers.name: twoSum
helpers.doc: Unsorted array, one pass with a map of value -> index.

helpers.name: maxSumWindow
helpers.doc: FIXED-size sliding window: add the entering element, drop the leaving one.

helpers.name: longestUniqueSubstring
helpers.doc: VARIABLE-size sliding window: grow right, shrink left while invalid.

helpers.name: prefixSums
helpers.doc: pre[i] = sum of nums[0..i). Range sum [i, j) == pre[j] - pre[i].

helpers.name: subarraySumEqualsK
helpers.doc: Count subarrays summing to k. Prefix sum + map of counts.

helpers.name: kadane
helpers.doc: Kadane: extend the previous run, or restart at x.

helpers.name: reverseRange
helpers.doc: In-place reverse of a subarray — the building block for rotations.

helpers.name: frequency
helpers.doc: merge(k, 1, Integer::sum) is the Java equivalent of freq.get(x, 0) + 1.

helpers.name: charFrequency
topKFrequent
helpers.doc: Bucket by count, then walk buckets high -> low. O(n), beats a heap.

helpers.name: hasDuplicate
binarySearch
helpers.doc: Exact match on a sorted array. Returns index or -1.

helpers.name: lowerBound
helpers.doc: First index with nums[i] >= target (Python's bisect_left).

helpers.name: upperBound
helpers.doc: First index with nums[i] > target (Python's bisect_right).

helpers.name: binarySearchAnswer
helpers.doc: 'Binary search on the answer' — what most interview problems actually want. feasible must be monotonic: false...false true...true. Returns smallest true x.

helpers.name: sortByCustom
helpers.doc: Sort by first ascending, then second descending. Use compare(), not a-b.

helpers.name: validParentheses
helpers.doc: ArrayDeque is the stack you want — java.util.Stack is legacy and synchronized.

helpers.name: nextGreater
helpers.doc: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices. res[i] = next element > nums[i], else -1.

helpers.name: kLargest
helpers.doc: Min-heap of size k -> the k largest survive. PriorityQueue is a MIN-heap.
